provenance.inputs_summary: Aspen Plus V15 stored baseline results (results/simulations/baseline.json, baseline_no_hi.json) costed by amcrax.economics.singapore; prices from backend/amcrax/data/singapore.yaml (scenarios)

model_versions.cost_basis: mixed 2024-2026 nominal USD; no escalation index applied

description: NH3 price (USD/t) at which LCOH equals each hydrogen benchmark; null means the benchmark is below the zero-ammonia-price conversion cost, i.e. unreachable. Benchmarks differ in basis; none is a Singapore transaction price.

sg_low_carbon_willingness_to_pay.source: S&P Global, 'Power generation firms face high hydrogen costs in Singapore', 7 May 2025: willingness to pay for low-carbon hydrogen in Singapore about 3 USD/kg (search-result summary; article not fetched)

ne_asia_smr_production_cost.source: Argus regional hydrogen cost markers, Northeast Asia baseline SMR incl. capex, 7 Apr 2026 sample (search-result summary); Nov 2025 value 3.34

blue_delivered_east_asia.source: ACE report estimate for delivered cost to East Asia: 5-7 USD/kg blue, 9-11 USD/kg green (search-result summary); 6.0 = midpoint (derived)

low_carbon_offer_fob_malaysia.source: S&P Global, indicative offers of low-carbon hydrogen at about 10 USD/kg FOB Malaysia, May 2025 (search-result summary)
